method.method_draft: Read from the image that the upper grey triangle has the rectangle's whole top side as its base and vertex A on the dashed line x, while the lower grey triangle has the rectangle's whole bottom side as its base and vertex B on the same dashed line x. From the text, x is parallel to a side of the rectangle and the two grey triangle areas sum to 10 cm^2. Let the rectangle have width W and height H, and let the distance from the top side down to line x be d. Then the distance from line x to the bottom side is H-d. The upper triangle area is (1/2)Wd and the lower triangle area is (1/2)W(H-d). Their sum is (1/2)WH, which is half the rectangle area. Since this sum is 10 cm^2, the rectangle area is 20 cm^2.
